prompt:
Draw EXACTLY TWELVE complete whole-character Darklight Requiem game sprites, 3 rows x4 columns, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Generous gutters, no labels/floor/cast shadow. Entire figures and attached armor/effects must stay separated and visible. Use crisp detailed pixel-style clusters, no blur.
References: 1 locks the CAMERA/DIRECTION of every pose;2 is the TARGET TRANSFORMATION and skin design authority;3 is complete-character natural low WALK gait guide;4 is eyes/skin reference.
SKIN: Requiem wears long black knee-length SLEEVED leather coat, black shirt and cargo trousers. Keep coat/sleeves.
FORM: ECLIPSE: individually drawn AMETHYST PURPLE shoulder CRYSTALS with distinct faceted geometry, vivid purple locks through lower brown wavy hair, violet coat/vest piping. Clear violet supernatural flame seams and small purple energy licks around neutral steel fists and armored feet.
CAMERA: W. WEST/true LEFT profile. Nose and toes point IMAGE LEFT; one eye visible, side coat and armor. Attack travels LEFT. Keep this view through ALL12, including walking/attacks. Transfer costume from ref2 into camera1. Do not copy ref2 front facing.
CRITICAL REPAIR: These forms must have independently authored transformed hair, actual shoulder crystals and costume trim, NEVER a red/purple color filter over a normal sprite. Metal armor stays DARK NEUTRAL STEEL with SILVER/brushed bronze lit facets and neutral charcoal recesses. Clothes stay black/charcoal. Colored light only on narrow magic seams and aura OUTSIDE fists/forearms/shins/feet. No tinted skin, colored cheek/neck shadows, red blush, red face outline or crimson shadow wash. Warm peach skin base RGB246,174,130 with SOFT DESATURATED PEACH/BROWN shadows, neutral outlines. Natural clean face. Red irises #C40814, darker iris #5A0000 ONLY within tiny actual eyes; do not paint eyelids or cheek red. Keep purple form PURPLE locks/crystals, not red.
Same young compact approved large-head proportions and identical scale across all poses. Preserve anatomical asymmetry and hip chain. Paired curved fang-ridged dark steel gauntlets fist-to-forearm and greaves shin-to-foot, recognizable original weapon silhouette. No handheld weapon. Draw NEW complete figures; no anatomy collage, image mirroring, flat rotations or hue overlays. Small contained form-colored impacts, no giant flames.
All12 left-to-right then next row:
0 WALK contact A: near leg forward heel contact, far leg trailing toe, near arm BACK. Small natural step, both knees low.
1 WALK passing A: supporting leg under hip; other boot passes close to ankle, barely off ground. Arms relaxed, subtle counter-swing.
2 WALK opposite contact B: far leg forward heel contact, near leg trailing toe; NEAR ARM FORWARD. Different limb overlap from0; do not repeat same leading leg.
3 WALK passing B: opposite supporting leg under hip; near boot passes by ankle, low knee; arm returning. Same natural low four-phase gait as reference3 adapted to requested camera.
No fighting guard for0-3, no marching, high knees or long sprinting stride. Arms swing loosely near thighs.
4 DODGE anticipation: both gauntlets tucked, weight drops, knees low.
5 DODGE low evasive side step, whole intact body, grounded support, modest translucent form-colored trail.
6 DODGE recovery to low guard, both feet grounding.
7 GUARD with gauntlets protecting torso/face, not hiding head entirely.
8 PARRY forearm deflects away incoming strike, compact form-colored spark.
9 HURT stagger/recoil, whole fists/feet remain, no blood or face stains.
10 DEATH buckles onto knee, head lowered, energy fades; whole figure remains intact.
11 DEATH final full body lying naturally on ground plane, hair/arms/legs/armor attached. Draw an anatomically prone figure, NOT a flat rotation of a standing sprite. No floor drawn. End pose held, not a walk loop.
All poses retain exact costume/equipment and same camera. Keep standing steps on common row baseline, all silhouettes separated.
